metadata.title: Chalo Yaar

home.title: Fuel dhoondein, madad paein

landing.logoAlt: Chalo Yaar ka logo: Fuel. Help. Move.
landing.heroTitle: Dekhein kin pumps par fuel hai, aur ye kis ne bataya.
landing.heroSubtitle: Qareebi stations par petrol, diesel aur CNG dekhein. Har haal ke saath report ka waqt likha hai.

facts.label: Chalo Yaar numbers mein
facts.labels: haal ke nishan, har ek ke saath report ka waqt
facts.languages: zabanein, aur har screen suni bhi ja sakti hai

landing.legendTitle: Unknown ka matlab hai abhi kisi ne confirm nahi kiya.
landing.legendBody: Har fuel ka haal 5 mein se ek nishan se dikhaya jata hai: icon, lafz aur report ka waqt. Sirf rang par bharosa nahi.

legend.available: Haal hi ki report ke mutabiq ye fuel mojood hai.
legend.queue: Fuel mojood hai, magar kisi driver ne line ki report di.
legend.stale: Aakhri report purani ho chuki hai. Jaane se pehle tasdeeq karein.
legend.unavailable: Haal hi ki report ke mutabiq ye fuel khatam hai.
legend.unknown: Is fuel ki abhi koi report nahi. Hum andaza lagane ke bajaye Unknown likhte hain, aur maloomat na hone ko khatam nahi samajhte.

landing.actionsTitle: Home screen par 4 button. Bas yehi poori app hai.
landing.actionsBody: Bare button, asaan alfaaz aur har screen par speaker, ek haath mein phone ke liye banaya gaya.

actions.fuel: Qareebi stations petrol, diesel ya CNG ke liye, haal, faasle aur raaste ke saath.
actions.help: Puncture, battery ya towing ki darkhwast, sirf aap ke ilaqe ke approved madadgaron ko.
actions.savings: Fuel bharwane ka asal kharcha dekhein, wahan tak jaane ke izafi fuel samait.
actions.car: Har dafa fuel ka record rakhein aur mileage aur mahana kharcha dekhein.

landing.voiceTitle: Har screen 4 zabanon mein suni ja sakti hai.
landing.voiceBody: Kisi bhi card par speaker dabayein. Zaban jab chahein badlein, aap ka intikhab isi phone par mehfooz rehta hai.
landing.voiceSample: Chalo Yaar fuel ka haal report ke waqt ke saath dikhata hai.
landing.stepsTitle: Apni gali se pump tak, 3 qadmon mein

location.title: Jagah batayein ya ilaqa chunein

choose.title: Qareebi stations dekhein

go.title: Raasta kholein

landing.joinTitle: Line dekhi? Agle driver ko batayein.
landing.joinDescription: Account ke saath aap station par fuel ka haal report kar sakte hain aur apni gaari save kar sakte hain.
landing.footerPilot: Faisalabad pilot. Demo likhe stations ki maloomat namoona hai.
